snippet.title: Day in the Life – Working as a Creative Professional in LA
snippet.description:
What's it like working at a startup company in Los Angeles? How do you take a slow and steady approach to a busy lifestyle? How do you get more stuff done in a day?

Hello, 👋 I'm Matthew Encina. I work as a creative professional in beautiful Los Angeles, California. 

In a previous life, I was a designer, animator, and a creative director working on TV commercials. Now I teach and create content at The Futur, an education startup,  where I help creative professionals sharpen their skills and earn money, doing what they love.

While no two days or experiences are exactly alike here, I hope to share a glimpse of what the world looks like, through my lens. This is a typical day in my life.

Details from this video, and affiliate links* below:

🎧 Do you like the music in this video? It's all from MusicBed. Use my link to get your first 30 days for free: http://share.mscbd.fm/matthewencinamusic

0:20 – LA drone footage provided by Mark Contreras

👨‍💻 0:25 – What do I do for a living?
I was a Creative Director at https://blind.com/
Now I make content and teach at https://www.youtube.com/thefuturishere

⏰ 0:52 – I try to wake up between 6-7am every day to make the most of the morning.

☕️ 1:06 – I LOVE coffee. Below are my favorite coffee tools.

AeroPress Coffee Maker: https://geni.us/aero

Tip: If you don't like your feed, curate it. Unfollow accounts and hide content that doesn't enrich your life.

About Matthew Encina
Director. Designer. Educator. Speaker.

Matthew Encina is an award-winning creative director of branding, interactive experiences, and video content for Fortune 500 brands, music artists, and video games. For over a decade he has been working on top-tier campaigns at LA’s premier design studios and agencies.

Matthew's graphic design background comes from his education from Art Center College of Design. Currently, he serves as a creative director at Blind, where he leads teams of designers, animators, and artists. Matthew is also a content creator at The Futur – a media and education company focused on teaching creativity and entrepreneurship.

Matthew's work has been featured in Fast Company, Inc., Rolling Stone, Creativity, The Wall Street Journal, MTV, and in film & design festivals around the world. He's spoken at international events, including TEDxCSULB and Siggraph. Some career highlights include his 3-time Webby Award-winning interactive music video “Ink” for Coldplay, and the CLIO award-winning “Jump Ahead” film for Xbox.
